findings.detail: «Борьба с преступностью» conveys crimefighting generally but loses the source's specific implication of teenage vigilante activity. Preserve that distinction in the target wording.

source_anchor.quote: the strain of balancing school and teenage vigilantism.

translation_anchor.quote: как тяжело совмещать школу и подростковую борьбу с преступностью.

findings.detail: The source says Damian responds «curtly», conveying brusqueness as well as brevity. «Короче» preserves shortness but not the curt tone; retain that edge in his response.
